draft_message.body: Update on CD-420437 (Bentley Flying Spur): the driver is on the way and currently expects to reach the Munich address around 16:30 local time. We will confirm once they are past the roadworks near Ingolstadt. That is slightly after the 16:00 end of the delivery window but before the 18:00 access time you gave us. To complete the handover we need the name and phone number of the person authorized to inspect and sign for the car, and they need to be on site from about 16:15 until 18:00. Is that Celia Hollowmere, or someone else? The driver will stay with the car and keys until we have that confirmed.
